provenance: output clip ported from pi packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/truncate.ts (2000 lines / 50KB). On clip, full stdout+stderr spills to workspace .cs-out/<n>.txt. Subprocess timeout is CS_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from the runner (minus 3s) so exec can emit `exec: timed out after N s` (exit 124) before the runner's wall clock.
description: Run a command inside the workspace sandbox. Pass {"cmd":["ls","docs"]} for direct argv, or {"cmd":"cd docs && ls | head"} (also accepts a bare JSON string) for /bin/sh syntax. With argv, use workspace-relative paths or absolute paths inside the workspace or read-only repository view. Parent traversal in argv is denied. Output over 2000 lines or 50KB is clipped and the full output is saved under .cs-out/.
